title: Sandra Bullock Says Government UFO Files Made Her Feel 'Vindicated'

content:
Sandra Bullock has opened up about a strange sighting from her time filming in Saint Martin. The Oscar-winning actress says she saw multiple lights moving together in the night sky. She believes the objects were not from Earth.

Sandra Bullock says she saw multiple UFOs flying over the sky while filming in Saint Martin

Bullock shared the story on Kylie Kelce's Not Gonna Lie podcast. "There are alien ships flying around the sky," the 62-year-old actress said. "I have seen them," she added, saying government files later made her feel "vindicated." Bullock also said she felt happy that the files made her feel less "insane" about what she saw.

The Blind Side and Miss Congeniality star said she saw the objects after filming in Saint Martin. She said a group went to the beach after production ended for the day. Bullock first noticed one small point of light and thought it was a satellite. Then, she saw more lights arrive from different directions until five lights came together.

Bullock said she had "a bit of a buzz" after having a few drinks when she watched the lights. She said the five objects suddenly "poof, took off" across the sky. Bullock said another person with her also saw the event. She later connected her sighting to government files that, according to Bullock, documented a similar formation seen by pilots.

Bullock didn't specify the production that led her to Saint Martin. However, her 1997 sequel Speed 2: Cruise Control filmed scenes in the Caribbean location. She also believes that aliens could be watching people without being noticed now. "I think they're here watching and laughing, but they're invisible," Bullock told Kelce.

Bullock is not the only celebrity who believes aliens may live among humans. The View moderator Whoopi Goldberg has made similar comments in 2024 and again this year. In June, Goldberg said, "They have been among us for a very long time," while she told Kumail Nanjiani in 2024, "They're already here," and later added, "They're watching us." Bullock's UFO story comes as she promotes Practical Magic 2, which hits theaters Sept. 10.
